title: A New Way to Speak at Meetings of the LA County Board of Supervisors
description:
Want to weigh in on something coming before the LA County Board of Supervisors? It just got a lot easier. 

We've launched a new online system that lets you sign up to speak at an upcoming Board meeting in just a few minutes — from any device, before you ever set foot in the chamber (or pick up the phone). 

Registration to speak opens at 9 a.m. the day of each meeting. To learn more, visit: bit.ly/BOS-How-To
